conditions: The first rule concerns a variable definition. The second concerns the scoped no-value declaration described in the manual.
limitations: The scope of a no-value declaration is the relevant file or region in the documented lexical environment. This wording leaves optimizer and compiler representation outside scope.

triggers: Exact publisher representation changed, source correction, or contrary language or edition evidence.

statement: In GNU Emacs 29.4 Emacs Lisp, variables defined with defvar, defcustom or defconst are special and remain dynamically bound with lexical binding enabled. A defvar declaration without a value can make bindings for a variable dynamic in only part of a file.
